items.author: Mehmet K.
items.text: I have been using it for 3 months, it was very easy to install. Zero problems in everyday use. You feel the quality of Turkish goods, the quality of construction is very good. Highly recommend.

items.author: Ayşe T.
items.text: The cable quality is really excellent. The Type 2 connector fits perfectly with the vehicle, plugging and unplugging is very fluid. The 7-meter length is ideal for garage use.

items.author: Serkan D.
items.text: Great convenience on holiday trips. Plug in the standard socket and start charging. I never leave my side when traveling, I also use it in emergencies. Very practical!

items.author: Emre Y.
items.text: We use it in the outdoor parking lot of our workplace. IP65 protection works perfectly even in the rain. We had a winter and had no problems. Domestic production gives confidence.

items.author: Özlem B.
items.text: It's great to get power from the car on a camping trip. The adapter is of good quality and works safely. I was able to turn on the laptop, the lights, even the small heater. Multi-brand compatibility is great.

items.author: Can M.
items.text: CCS connection works perfectly. The cable is flexible, does not have difficulty in crimping and unfolding. Connection quality is superior, no heating at high current. Best option on the market.
